# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Agatha  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c9 P18](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0018)</sub>; Agatha  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P27](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0027), [v2 c22 P11](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is a woman of heavy and awkward build.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019)_

## Personality

She takes pride in voicing her opinions bluntly and without fear or partiality. Known throughout the community as a sharp-tongued, assertive, and inveterate meddler, she frequently compresses severe commentary into brief, direct remarks. Despite her overbearing demeanor, she possesses a deeply compassionate heart, regularly aiding the needy and extending silent charity toward her neighbors. She is also a devoted and capable wife who takes charge of managing household matters.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c9 P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v2 c22 P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013)_

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby spent her married life asserting full command over her husband, Thomas Sowerby, who depended completely on her management and direction. She raised ten children and survived the loss of two. Shortly after Obed Abernethy brought the young orphan Nell to Grey Shutters, Agatha visited and openly criticized the child's scrawny frame and freckled face, provoking a furious outburst from Nell and earning a rare rebuke from Thirza Abernethy. Over time, Nell grew to understand Agatha's charitable nature, such as when Agatha silently overlooked Timothy Cotton stealing butter from her dairy. In later years, Agatha solicited community funds for a vestry room carpet, irritating Mr. Pettifer with her forceful style. As her husband's health steadily declined, forcing him to spend his days on the couch, Agatha became increasingly homebound and despondent, nursing him devotedly while facing the prospect of eventual isolation.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c9 P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v2 c22 P11](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0011), [v2 c22 P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013)_
